products.description:
Introducing the new CELINE Bonnie backpack for spring, designed as an elegant and relaxed alternative to the traditional handbag.

Featured in our iconic toile canvas, the Bonnie backpack joins the timeless line of leather goods in our CELINE Essentials collection. The Triomphe canvas reprises the couture house's historic monogram first revealed in 1972 : a link motif inspired by the chain around the Arc de Triomphe.

The Bonnie backpack is also crafted from smooth calfskin leather offering both suppleness and structure in other essential colors.
